scope: 77 original TRAIN designs/4454 physical clips only. Reserved selection/calibration/test untouched. No structural generation, new features/architecture, supervised sample reweighting, asymmetric loss, penalty/band sweep, prediction clipping or deployment adoption. Fresh noise is not independent structural validation.
features: Frozen full174 two-mode spatial representation, selected16/causal51/cap50/lag64/max8. Reuse four original training views clean, iid1_seed928, iid5_seed928, iid1_seed929 and all21 cached acquisition probes plus prior8 confirmation conditions for exploration. Pair ONLY the two independent iid1 views of the same source clip; same design/target asserted. 5% training remains supervised, without a dedicated paired5% consistency term; report that limitation.
objective: All arms use the SAME custom32->16 ReLU network, initialization42/43/44, alpha1, train-fold scaling/inactive mask and L-BFGS-B maxiter10000/maxfun200000/gtol1e-7. Base objective0.5*mean supervised squared error + alpha/(2*n_training_rows)*weight norm squared. Arms: supervised lambda0; global lambda1 uniform pair weights; localized lambda1 pair weight indicator(abs(true_margin)<.05) on BOTH sides of flutter. Pair penalty lambda/2 * sum(weight*prediction_gap_squared)/sum(weight). Normalization matches overall penalty coefficient, not per-clip regularization strength; concentration inherently increases influence per included pair. Labels weight TRAINING only, never inference routing. No skip or additional local error weighting. Same training views and optimizer for all three arms isolate objective effects; native full174/one107/blend50 remain frozen references, not interchangeable optimizer controls.

Source/package fingerprints, native serialized custom predictors, fit messages, objective components, pair weights, source identities, and train/OOF predictions retained atomically. Nonconvergence is reported and makes an arm ineligible; no hidden retries or parameter changes.

metrics: Global macro design MAE; stable/unstable last1/2/5%; mean signed error, over/under exceedance0/.005/.01/.02/.03/.05; zero-threshold wrong-side fractions; farther-stable margin>=.15 underestimation>.05; in-sample versus held-out gap; per-seed/fold consistency. Report repeated-draw boundary prediction variance/sign disagreement and paired bias decomposition: disagreement reduction alone is insufficient. 2000 paired whole-design resamples of seed/exposure metrics, no refit/seed uncertainty or multiplicity correction.
acceptance: Zero allowed deterioration, retained conservative research rule. A localized replacement must have paired95% upper bound<0 for stable last1% macro MAE versus matched supervised, and <=0 for unstable last1% MAE, stable/unstable last1% wrong-sign rates, global MAE and farther-stable under>.05, on EVERY new1% condition; require all those upper bounds<=0 on EVERY5% stress condition. Separately report identical noninferiority checks versus frozen one107/blend50: no default replacement unless both reference guardrail sets pass. A zero-crossing interval is not proof of noninferiority. Report point checks separately, and comparisons to global consistency/full174. Require all45 fits converged, disclose seed/fold inconsistency, and report engineering latency rather than claiming hard deadlines. No blanket success if any condition fails.
timing: Warm single-thread full raw25-channel-to-prediction on77 fixed first-row/design iid1_seed949 clips,10 repetitions/arm, rotating order. One modal estimate; feature/calibration/train-fold transform/native custom forwards included. Timing vehicles seed42/fold0; frozen one/full/blend retained. Acquisition/noise generation/disk/startup excluded. Check raw feature/native prediction replay, median/p95/max and paired overhead;10ms p95 only an engineering screen.
decision: No follow-on sweep or automatic correction. If localized consistency reduces variability but not errors/decisions, reject it as a solution. Any improvement without full acceptance is a bounded candidate/diagnostic, not deployment qualification. Keep current default unchanged and GRU live for a later improved-representation comparison. This study is margin-loss intervention, not a newly trained warning classifier or threshold recalibration.
